questions.question: A can do a piece of work in 2 days, and B can do five times the same work in 15 days when they work for ten hours a day. If they work together, then how many hours in addition to a day's work will they require to complete the work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken to complete a work by A = 2 days

Time taken to complete a work by B = five times the same work in 15 days

**Formula used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Time taken to complete a work by B = five times the same work in 15 days = (15/5) 

⇒ 3 days

A work for ten hours a day = (2 × 10) = 20 

B works for ten hours a day = (3 × 10) = 30

LCM of 20 and 30 is 60

Efficiency of A = (60/20) = 3 units/day

Efficiency of B = (60/30) = 2 units/day

Time taken by A and B together to complete a work = [60/(3 + 2)]

⇒ (60/5)

⇒ 12 hrs

Now,

Addition hours required to complete the work by them = (12 – 10) hrs

⇒ 2 hrs

**∴ The required additional time is 2 hrs**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c614478f2cb0183a00cf0789be77b603a9da13b1f6a762329f533d127d3bf83.png] 

So, 

A + B will complete in 60/5 = 12 hours

So, extra time = 12 - 10 = 2 hours

questions.question: A loan is to be returned in two equal yearly instalments. If the rate of interest is 10% p.a., compounded annually and each instalment is Rs. 6534, then the total interest charged (in Rs.) is:
questions.solution:

Annual installment (x) = Rs. 6534

Total number of installments (N) = 2

**Formula used:**

P = [x/(1 + R/100)] + [x/(1 + R/100)²] + ........ + [x/(1 + R/100)ⁿ] 

**Calculation:**

Total number of installments = 2

The value of 2 installments = Rs. (2 × 6534)

⇒ Rs. 13068

Now,

P = [x/(1 + R/100)] + [x/(1 + R/100)2]

⇒ P = [6534/(1 + 10/100)] + [6534/(1 + 10/100)²]

⇒ P = [6534/(110/100)] + [6534/(110/100 × 110/100)]

⇒ P = (6534 × 10/11) + (6534 × 10/11 × 10/11)

⇒ P = 5940 + 5400

⇒ P = Rs. 11340

Total interest charged = Value of 2 installments – Principal borrowed

⇒ Total interest charged = Rs. (13068 – 11340)

⇒ Rs. 1728

**∴ The total interest charged in this installment scheme is Rs. 1728**

questions.question: The average weight of a certain number of students in a class is 55.5 kg. If 4 students with average weight 60 kg join the class, then the average weight of all students in the class increases by 360 g. The number of students in the class, initially, is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average weight of a certain number of students in a class = 55.5 kg

4 students with average weight 60 kg join the class, the average weight of all students in the class increases by 360 g (0.360 Kg). 

**Formula used:**

Average = sum of observations/Number of observations

**Calculation:**

Let the number of students initially be x.

Sum = Average × Number of students

Total initial weight = 55.5x kg

Weight of new students = (4 × 60) = 240 kg

The new average = 55.5 + 0.360 = 55.86

New average = (55.5x + 240)/(x + 4) = 55.86

⇒ 55.5x + 240 = 55.86x + 223.44

⇒ (55.86x – 55.5x) = (240 – 223.44)

⇒ 0.36x = 16.56

⇒ x = (16.56/0.36)

⇒ x = 46

**∴ The number of students in the class, initially, is 46**

questions.question: The marked price of an article is Rs. 5320. It is subject to two successive discounts, the first being 15%, and the second at a rate of 20% of the first. What is the selling price (to nearest Rs.) of the article?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The marked price = Rs. 5320

Two successive discounts = 15%, and the second at a rate of 20% of the first.

**Formula used:**

Single discount on two successive discounts = (a + b – ab/100)

**Calculation:**

Let the selling price be 100

According to the question

The second at a rate of 20% of the first = (20% of 15)

⇒ (20/100 × 15) = 3%

Now, single discount on two successive discount = (a + b – ab/100)

⇒ (15 + 3 – 15 × 3/100)

⇒ (18 – 0.45) = 17.55%

Now, (100 – 17.55)% = 82.45%

Selling price = (82.45% of 5320)

⇒ (82.45/100 × 5320)

⇒ (438634/100)

⇒ Rs. 4386.34 ~ Rs. 4386

**∴ The required selling price is Rs. 4386**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] __Mistake Points__**Note the language of the question

"second at a rate of 20% of the first " which means 20% of 15 = 3%.

Don't take the second discount = 20 %. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Given that, the marked price is Rs. 5320

According to the question

The second at a rate of 20% of the first = (20% of 15)

⇒ (20/100 × 15) = 3%

Hence, the selling price 

SP = 5320× (1-(15)/(100))(1-(3)/(100))

⇒ SP = (5320 × 85 × 97)/10000

⇒ SP = 4386

Hypotenuse² = Opposite² + Adjacent²

questions.question: A boat goes 30 km upstream in 3 hours and downstream in 1 hour. How much time (in hours) will this boat take to cover 60 km in still water?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A boat goes 30 km upstream in 3 hours 

A boat goes 30 km downstream in 1 hour

**Formula used:**

Downstream = u + v

Upstream = u – v

**Calculation:**

According to the question

A boat goes 30 km upstream in 3 hours 

⇒ (u – v) = 30/3

⇒ u – v = 10 .....(1)

Again,

A boat goes 30 km downstream in 1 hour

⇒ (u + v) = 30/1

⇒ u + v = 30 .....(2)

Adding the equation (1) and (2), we get

⇒ u – v = 10 + u + v = 30

⇒ 2u = 40

⇒ u = 20

Now,

Time taken to cover 60 km in still water = (60/20)

⇒ 3

**∴ The required time is 3 hrs**

questions.question: AB is a chord of a circle with centre O and P is any point on the circle. If ∠APB = 122°, then what is the measure of ∠OAB ?
questions.solution:
Given:

∠APB = 122° 

Concept used:

Sum of opposite sides of a cyclic quadrilateral are 180°

The angle subtended by an arc of a circle at its center is twice the angle it subtends anywhere on the circle’s circumference.

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e99344c905022284275a4d1853992192a36e5338ef736ea9d5de7f014e627d3.png] 

In the given figure,

APBT is a cyclic quadrilateral.

∠ATB + ∠APB = 180° [sum of opposite angles are 180°]

⇒ x° + 122° = 180° 

⇒ x = (180° – 122°)

⇒ x = 58° 

∠ATB = 58° 

And we know that the angle subtended by an arc of a circle at its center is twice the angle it subtends anywhere on the circle’s circumference.
